title: winter-wholesome smoky spanish kale crema catalana
description: a smoky, springy spanish dish featuring kale, yuzu-cure, and a creamy catalan custard served in a korean brass bowl

ingredients.name: yuzu juice
ingredients.notes: cured in salt for at least 30 minutes

instructions: cure the yuzu juice and shallots in a mixture of salt and yuzu juice for at least 30 minutes
heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
add the kale and cook until wilted
stir in the smoked paprika, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper
in a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, sugar, and a pinch of salt
pour the egg mixture over the kale mixture and stir to combine
season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste
pour the mixture into a korean brass bowl and top with the yuzu-cured shallots and chopped parsley
bake at 375f for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly
